title: ReasoningResponse
description: Returned by Person 2's POST /reason (request: {graph: GraphData, fieldConfidence: FieldConfidence | null, chartAspect: number | null}, where chartAspect is the drawn plot's height / width, default 0.6). Everything the frontend needs in one call, so exploration and preset questions work with no further network requests. Call /reason again after any user correction.

highlight.description: Points the answer refers to, for focusing or highlighting in the UI.

caveats.description: Uncertainty to announce, e.g. unreadable values or low confidence.

text.description: One sentence on the graph's shape, including where the line ends, e.g. 'It spikes to 8.1 percent in 2020, then falls back to 4 percent by 2024.' If values could not be read, a short clause follows, e.g. '2020 could not be read.' (up to 3 labels, then 'and N more'). Spoken right after Person 3's describeAxes (type, title, axes), so it does not repeat them. Spoken numbers use at most 1 decimal when the value range is over 1. GraphData.summary is ignored.

compare.description: With one series, answers that there is nothing to compare.

series.description: One entry per series; each is explored independently.

intro.description: Spoken when the user switches to this series.

normalised.description: (value - min) / (max - min) over ALL series, so series share one pitch scale. 0.5 if every value is equal.

delta.description: Change from the previous point; null for the first point or when either value is missing.

changeStrength.description: |delta| / (max - min), capped at 1. 0 for the first point; null when either value is missing.

direction.description: Versus the previous point; moves under 2% of the value range are flat. 'flat' for the first point; 'unknown' when this or the previous value is missing.

isTurningPoint.description: A big landmark where the trend reverses (peak or low): both legs, to the neighbouring kept turn or the series end, move at least 10% of the value range. The series max and min are always kept. Smaller wobbles are not turning points.

readout.description: Brief, ready-to-speak: value and landmark only, no unit or change, e.g. '2020: 8.1, highest.' or 'Q3: unreadable.' The change lives in explain.

explain.description: Spoken by the Explain button for this point: coordinates, landmark, change from the previous readable point and what comes next, e.g. '2020, 8.1 percent. The highest point, up 4.4 percentage points from 2019; after this it falls.' or '2017, 4.4 percent, down 0.5 percentage points from 2016.' A null point: '2020 could not be read.' Same text as interestPoints[].explain.

trace.description: The line as segments, for the ring. startFraction/endFraction are x positions on the plot (0 = left edge, 1 = right edge); they also work as time fractions for a timed sweep.

angle.description: Slope as drawn (on a plot chartAspect times as tall as wide): 0 = flat (point the ring right), +90 = straight up, -90 = straight down. null over an unreadable gap.

strength.description: |change| / value range; null over a gap.

interestPoints.description: Stops for the Explore page's 'Next point' button, left to right: start, big peaks and lows (see isTurningPoint), max, min, end. At most 6: the least prominent peaks and lows are dropped first; start, end, max and min always stay.

xFraction.description: Where to guide the finger horizontally.

normalised.description: Where to guide the finger vertically (0 = bottom of the value range).

explain.description: Spoken by the Explain button: same text as points[index].explain.

lowConfidence.description: graph.confidence or fieldConfidence.series below 0.6; numbers are then spoken as 'about ...'.

phrasing.description: Whether texts were reworded by Gemini (USE_LLM=1) or are the deterministic templates.
